title: Base UI Migration Quote Desk
oneLiner: Frontend teams turn a shadcn/Radix-to-Base UI migration into a client-ready scope, risk, and quote packet.
targetUser: Freelance frontend developers, agencies, and internal design-system owners maintaining shadcn/ui projects.
keyUX: Scan component inventory, mark risky primitives, estimate effort by screen, and generate a migration quote with before/after proof.
sourceSignalReferences: S2: Hada: shadcn/ui switches new projects from Radix to Base UI - https://news.hada.io/topic?id=31163
S3: GitHub trending shows runnable LLM apps and local-first Home Assistant - https://github.com/trending
twist: Converts framework churn into sellable scope clarity instead of a generic developer changelog.
smallGroupFit: Agencies can use it on one client repository to avoid underquoting component migration work.
spreadTrigger: The quote packet gives clients a concrete reason to approve the migration budget.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "Base UI Migration Quote Desk" for frontend teams moving shadcn/Radix projects toward Base UI. Include component inventory, Radix vs Base dependency lanes, risk and effort scoring, screen-by-screen quote table, regression checklist, client explanation copy, and migration packet export. Design direction: use the financial-analyst profile with clean tables, sober effort math, precise risk deltas, and quote-ready summaries that feel credible to a client.
